boards.school_name: University of North Carolina at Charlotte
boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented UNC Charlotte study environments, from silent reading rooms to technology-enabled and family-friendly library spaces.

cards.entity_name: Atkins Room G02 — Compact Shelving & Graduate and Silent Study
cards.title: Compact Shelving Silent Study
cards.subtitle: J. Murrey Atkins Library, ground floor
cards.notes: Use Room G02 when you need a silent setting. Keep phones muted and use headphones or earbuds; conversations and group study are not permitted.
cards.short_summary: A designated silent-study room on Atkins Library’s ground floor.
cards.evidence_claim: Atkins designates Ground Floor Room G02, Compact Shelving & Graduate Study Area, as a silent-study area.
cards.source_title: Building & Space Use Policies | J. Murrey Atkins Library
cards.access_notes: Silent-study rules apply: no group study or conversations; phones must be muted and headphones or earbuds worn.

cards.entity_name: Atkins Room 115 — Graduate & Silent Study Room
cards.title: Graduate & Silent Study Room
cards.subtitle: J. Murrey Atkins Library, first floor
cards.notes: Set up in Room 115 for a distraction-limited session. This is a designated silent area, so plan solo work and keep your phone muted.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor designated silent-study room at Atkins Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Atkins identifies Room 115 on the first floor as the Graduate & Silent Study Room and designates it for silent study.
cards.source_title: Study & Quiet/Silent Spaces | J. Murrey Atkins Library
cards.access_notes: No group study or conversations are permitted in designated silent areas; phones should be muted and headphones or earbuds worn.

cards.entity_name: West Side Third-Floor Quiet Study Area
cards.title: Third-Floor Quiet Zone
cards.subtitle: J. Murrey Atkins Library, west side overlooking the SAC
cards.notes: Choose the west side of the third floor for independent work with a quieter expectation. Use headphones, mute your phone, and keep any conversation whispered.
cards.short_summary: A designated quiet-study area overlooking the Student Activities Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Atkins designates the west side of its third floor, overlooking the SAC, for quiet study.
cards.source_title: Building & Space Use Policies | J. Murrey Atkins Library
cards.access_notes: For independent study and brief, whispered conversations only; phones should be muted and headphones or earbuds worn.

cards.entity_name: Mary & Harry L. Dalton Rare Book and Manuscript Room
cards.title: Dalton Reading Room
cards.subtitle: J. Murrey Atkins Library, tenth floor
cards.notes: Bring quiet reading or writing to the Dalton Room. Leave bags at the front and keep food and drinks outside; collection researchers receive seating priority.
cards.short_summary: A free public reading room for quiet study beside rare books and archives.
cards.evidence_claim: The Dalton Reading Room is free and open to the public, and is available for anyone seeking a quiet place to study.
cards.source_title: Special Collections | J. Murrey Atkins Library
cards.access_notes: No food or drinks; leave backpacks, bags, and coats at the front. Users of rare books and archival materials have priority.

cards.entity_name: Atkins Tenth-Floor Open Quiet Study Area
cards.title: Tenth-Floor Open Quiet Study
cards.subtitle: J. Murrey Atkins Library, tenth floor
cards.notes: Head to the tenth-floor open area for quiet work with comfortable seating and campus views. Check availability first, since the floor can close for special events.
cards.short_summary: An open quiet-study area with comfortable seating on Atkins Library’s tenth floor.
cards.evidence_claim: Atkins Library’s tenth floor has an open quiet-study area with comfortable seating and views of campus and the surrounding area.
cards.source_title: Tenth Floor | J. Murrey Atkins Library
cards.access_notes: Normally open 9 a.m.–5 p.m. Monday–Friday, but sometimes closed for special events.

cards.title: Hight Architecture Library
cards.subtitle: Storrs Hall, Room 200
cards.notes: Use the Hight Library for quiet study among design and built-environment resources. Check with library staff before evening or weekend visits for Storrs Hall access details.
cards.short_summary: UNC Charlotte’s branch architecture library, with study tables, computers, and design collections.
cards.evidence_claim: The Charles C. Hight Architecture Library is in Storrs Room 200 and is open to UNC Charlotte affiliates and the public to visit and study.
cards.source_title: Architecture Library | J. Murrey Atkins Library
cards.access_notes: Located on the second floor of Storrs Hall. Review the library hours calendar; ask staff before evening or weekend visits about building access.

cards.title: Area 49
cards.subtitle: J. Murrey Atkins Library, second floor
cards.notes: Bring a project that benefits from hands-on exploration or technology. Area 49 welcomes current students at every experience level; space-specific hours vary.
cards.short_summary: A campus innovation and creation space for developing ideas with technology and making.
cards.evidence_claim: Area 49 is a second-floor Atkins Library collection of innovation and creation spaces open to all current students, faculty, and staff.
cards.access_notes: Open to current students, faculty, and staff. Hours vary by individual space and are listed on each space’s page.

cards.title: ANSWER Family-Friendly Room 206
cards.subtitle: J. Murrey Atkins Library, second floor
cards.notes: Reserve Room 206 when caregiving is part of your study day. It is a campus resource designed to support adult students while they care for children or dependents.
cards.short_summary: A named family-friendly library room intended to support studying while caregiving.
cards.evidence_claim: Atkins identifies ANSWER Family-Friendly Library Room 206 as a campus resource for adult students caring for children and dependents.
cards.source_title: Study & Quiet/Silent Spaces | J. Murrey Atkins Library
cards.access_notes: Located on Atkins Library’s second floor; confirm current room availability through the library’s reservation information.

cards.title: ANSWER Family-Friendly Room 209
cards.subtitle: J. Murrey Atkins Library, second floor
cards.notes: Plan a study block in Room 209 if you are caring for a child or dependent. The library documents it as a family-friendly resource for adult students.
cards.short_summary: A second named family-friendly room in Atkins Library’s student-support spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Atkins identifies ANSWER Family-Friendly Library Room 209 as a campus resource for adult students caring for children and dependents.
cards.source_title: Study & Quiet/Silent Spaces | J. Murrey Atkins Library
cards.access_notes: Located on Atkins Library’s second floor; confirm current room availability through the library’s reservation information.

cards.title: Video Viewing Room
cards.subtitle: J. Murrey Atkins Library, Room 114A
cards.notes: Use Room 114A to work with course-reserve video or library DVD, VHS, and record collections. Bring or check out headphones to preserve the quiet nearby.
cards.short_summary: A first-come, first-served media viewing room for course and library materials.
cards.evidence_claim: Atkins Video Viewing Room 114A is open to current students, faculty, and staff and has DVD, VHS, and record players.
cards.source_title: Microforms & Video Viewing | J. Murrey Atkins Library
cards.access_notes: Stations are first-come, first-served during regular library hours; headphone or earbud use is required with players.
